finalText:
**Found it and fixed it.** The leak was in `src/jobs/processOrder.js`.

It grabbed a connection, ran the order, then released. When the order failed, the release line never ran. Every bad order kept a connection forever.

The worker log shows it plainly. Jobs 4122, 4123 and 4125 all failed with `invalid order payload`, and each one pushed `pool in-use` up a notch with no "connection released" line. At 5/5 the worker died, then the API followed.

`processOrder` now goes through `withConnection`, the same wrapper the request path already used. It releases in a `finally`, so a failure can't hold a connection.

All 4 tests pass, 66ms.
